steps.note: Status bar reactivity (quadraui#918): ShellApp's bottom status bar (a widget outside both the sidebar and the main content area) shows last_message, which the app updates on every SidebarEvent::RowSelected. Starting from the 'nothing selected' baseline, selecting one row must update it, and selecting a DIFFERENT row must update it again — not just show the first selection forever, and not just be correct in the single-click case layout/shell.sidebar_left_of_main already covers. Clicks use the right_edge anchor, matching that scenario's own precedent for resolving nested tree rows reliably.
A second, different selection must overwrite the first rather than append to it or stick.
